text:
𝟮𝟬𝟭𝟭! 𝟮𝟴 𝗬𝗘𝗔𝗥𝗦 𝗟𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗥 🏆

India beat Sri Lanka by 6 wickets at the Wankhede on 2 April 2011.
Dhoni 91* and Gambhir 97 chased down 275. India lifted the World Cup at home. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #2011WorldCup

👉 Wankhede, 2 April 2011 – Sri Lanka ko 6 wicket se haraya
👉 MS Dhoni ke 91* aur Gautam Gambhir ke 97
👉 Ghar mein World Cup jeetne wali pehli host team

Dhoni ka wo winning six aap kabhi bhool sakte hain? Comment karo 👇
